{{Quote|I sense a sickness in the Force [&hellip;] I believe Darth Mekhis is here.|Ngani Zho|<ref name="The Lost Suns 5" />}}
'''Darth Mekhis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who served as the head of the [[Sphere of Technology]] during the entire [[Great Galactic War]] and most of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Greatly warped by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Mekhis was a brilliant [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], creating weapons for the Sith Empire. She was defeated by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Satele Shan]] at the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] near the end of the Great War, but survived and continued to construct [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] throughout the Cold War that followed. She was ultimately killed in [[3643 BBY]], when the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]] sabotaged her [[Sun Razer]] project in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] and paralyzed Mekhis, leaving her to die when the Sun Razer exploded.

==Biography==
Darth Mekhis, a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who served on the [[Dark Council]] in the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], led the Sith forces in the [[Battle of Rhen Var]], establishing a [[Darth Mekhis' fortress|fortress]] as a command center until [[Satele Shan]] and her Republic forces arrived. Breaking open the door to Mekhis's chamber with the Force, Shan asked the Sith Lord to surrender and offered protection in exchange. However, Mekhis refused, and the two began a fierce duel that resulted in Mekhis being grievously injured before she escaped.<ref name="The Lost Suns 1" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Darth Mekhis served as a weapon designer working on projects to give the Sith the advantage when hostilities resumed, most of them produced at the [[Sun Razer]] facility she created to provide the resources to construct them. Mekhis designed a new and experimental class of warship called the [[Javelin Dreadnought]], capable of using its weapons to flash irradiate a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], wiping out all life below within a three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] radius. She christened the prototype ''Ror'jhan'', which meant "she-whose-leaves-sweat-poison" in the [[Sith (language)|Sith]] language.

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Mekhis also had in her employ a legion of [[Darth Mekhis' Sith Knights|Sith Knights]], semi-mechanical thralls created from captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and corrupted by her power. She was later seen aboard her [[Sun Razer]] in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] completing the last modification when the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Eisek]] informed her of the capture of [[Theron Shan]] and Master [[Ngani Zho]] and she immediately ordered the execution of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Things took an unexpected turn when the two of them escaped. Ngani eventually died, protecting the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Teff'ith]] from blaster shots. In the same time, Theron made his way to Mekhis, and after revealing his relation to [[Satele Shan]] to throw her off guard, defeated her using a toxicity-ten poison, leaving her on the Sun Razer as it exploded. Her rival, [[Darth Hadra]], took her place on the Dark Council.

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Mekhis could utilize [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="The Lost Suns 5" />
